How to read this

DemandAre more people searching for it than a year ago (last 2 years only), and is Amazon selling units? Green = rising.
Same product in shopsA PHOTO search in each country, then a check of what a shopper finds by typing the product words. Red = in a big chain. Amber = a cheaper copy shoppers will find or trust. Light green = copies exist but are hidden or about the same price. Green = nobody else.
AmazonAre there listings with thousands of reviews? Green = not yet.
AdvertisersHow many brands run Facebook ads for it today, and when did they start? One brand for months = proof. Dozens in the last few weeks = a swarm.
Cost to buyWhat a supplier such as AliExpress charges for it, and what that leaves you per sale. Green = 70% or more left.

Best region: Both are light green: copies exist but shoppers do not find them.

Proof the price gap is survivable: Go Crimp has kept ads running for 10 months at US$59 while copies sell for less than half that in 1 of 2 countries. Shoppers are paying the gap, so a cheaper copy existing has not stopped this product selling.

Picture check   Identical The same pistol-grip device at a fifth of the price.

Climber's Finger Trainer (GripX Pro)
Hand Strength Trainer (Amazon Australia, A$18)

Why test now

  • Go Crimp has kept ads live since November 2025 and now runs most of the live ads for it. Nobody pays that long for ads that lose money
  • The copies are hidden: in both countries none shows up when a shopper types the product words into Amazon or Google, and the best-known one has 14 reviews
  • A supplier clearly exists (the same device retails at A$18), so the margin at US$59 is large

Biggest risk

The copies are hidden today, not gone. If the product takes off they will surface, and Go Crimp already owns the climbers.

What to do next

  • Start in the US or Australia
  • Take it to an audience Go Crimp ignores: guitarists, golfers or hand rehab. 3 short ads, US$20 a day for 5 days

Before you order, ask the supplier

  • What is the total cost delivered to my customer's country, per unit?
  • How many days from order to the customer's door?
  • Can you send one sample first, and do you have the safety paperwork this product needs?
